i.norm: The Calinski-Harabasz score is defined as a ratio of between-cluster dispersion to within-cluster dispersion. With only a single cluster the between-cluster dispersion and the (k - 1) degrees-of-freedom term are both zero, so the score evaluates to NaN.

Build one cluster holding two points in 5-dimensional space. The shared backing array is mutated between the two DoublePoint constructions, so the first point is the origin (all zeros) and the second point differs only in its last coordinate.
